Name: Sarah M.
Review: Parastoo held the space so gently that I finally let my shoulders drop for the first time in years. I did not know how much I had been carrying until I put it down.

Name: Leila K.
Review: I came expecting a massage and left having met a part of myself I had been avoiding. She works with a rare kind of attention.

Name: Tom R.
Review: The retreat changed the shape of my year. Six months on I am still living from what opened up there.

Name: Ana Sofía
Review: Nunca me había sentido tan acompañada en un proceso así. Parastoo tiene una calma que se contagia.

Name: Marcus B.
Review: Honest, grounded, and completely without the spiritual performance I was braced for. That is the highest compliment I have.

Name: Nadia F.
Review: She listened to my body before she touched it. That is the whole thing, really.
